On a special opening, rules for the care team
This section explains the steps for the whole desk

Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: keep every animal safe, calm, and ready for movement through Aurelia Skyways.

Staff must check travel papers before acceptance and confirm that the carrier is clean, secure, and suited to the animal. Handle all cases with steady care, since safety takes priority over speed in every journey. If a passenger is anxious, the desk must listen closely, explain the next steps in plain words, and avoid promises that cannot be kept. The ground team must move carriers carefully between services, and no bag, crate, or label may be left without attention.

<<FACT F067>> Staff must place the animal in the approved carrier only after the check is complete, and the carrier must stay closed until release is authorized. Any sign of distress, damage, or delay must be reported at once to the senior coordinator. If a traveler brings more than one animal, each case must be tracked separately, and documents must stay matched to the right carrier.

<<FACT F083>> For birds, staff must verify the record before handoff and refuse boarding if the papers are incomplete or unclear. Keep all notes brief, accurate, and visible to the next shift so the desk remains ready for the next service. If Baxter or any other pet arrives in poor condition, the desk must escalate the matter without delay and protect the animal first.

For immediate concerns, contact the senior coordinator, the ground supervisor, or the duty manager at once.
